entities.summary: Bhumibol, a notable figure in the history of Thailand, associated with Cold War Military Dictatorships (1957–1973). Preceded by Thailand hosts US military bases during the Vietnam War. Their legacy influenced Student uprising topples the Thanom-Praphas military dictatorship and Black May — pro-democracy uprising against General Suchinda's coup.
